_comment: Hot-reloaded every loop. Edit + push from anywhere; takes effect on the next signal.
_symbol_map_comment: TV alert symbol -> broker symbol. NAMING RECONCILIATION ONLY: both sides must be the SAME instrument under different vendor names. NEVER map to a different contract (e.g. USOIL->BRENT) — the signal's level/extreme/price were computed on the source chart and do not transfer across instruments. XAUUSD1! is deliberately absent: futures continuous is a different contract from spot, so it stays in ignore_symbols. Broker names verified against get_symbols 23 Jul 2026.
_instrument_policy_comment: EMPTIED 23 Jul 2026 at Evan's instruction — no blanket instrument bans. Rationale is not just preference, it measured false: spread as % of daily range on 23 Jul 07:xx SAST was NAS100 0.36%, BRENT 0.53%, WTI 0.64%, EURUSD 2.92%. WTI — banned for being 'too spread driven' — is 4.5x CHEAPER to trade than the pair the system trades most. The list was also structurally redundant: R:R is computed from live ask (buys) / bid (sells), so spread is already priced into every Rule 9 decision. Banning an instrument double-counted a cost the R:R gate already measures, using a frozen opinion instead of a live quote. News-driven whipsaw (the other stated concern) is Rule 11's job and is also evaluated live. Mechanism retained but empty: add an entry here only with a dated measurement showing an instrument fails on its own numbers.
_orb_comment: ORB v1 routing (added 23 Jul 2026, see STRATEGY_ORB.md). OR_COMPLETE is the actionable event: it arrives the instant the opening range closes and carries entry/sl/tp/expires_ms, so the session can rest a stop order rather than needing to be present at the break. ORB_LONG/ORB_SHORT are after-the-fact confirmations for the log. TIME_EXIT must reach Tier 2 because flattening a position is an action, not an observation.
_limit_comment: Usage-limit circuit breaker. On a usage/session-limit failure the runner opens a breaker for limit_cooldown_min, doubling per consecutive hit up to limit_cooldown_max_min. While open it consumes the cursor, counts skips and sends NOTHING. One push on open, one on resume. Fixes ~3h of duplicate limit notifications caused by retrying a per-account limit once per incoming signal.
